q: State the independence test for a guardrail.
o: It moves with the success metric
If the change works as intended, it shouldn't move
why: A real guardrail watches a different system your change could damage.

q: A cheaper Plus Lite plan aims to raise checkout conversion. Which is a diagnostic, not a guardrail?
o: Checkout conversion on the yearly plan only
why: It re-measures the success metric on a slice.

q: "Monitor the app rating" is a guardrail.
why: Myth. A guardrail needs a numeric roll-back rule decided before shipping.
Twelve guardrails means nobody watches any.

q: Conversion went 6.0% → 6.5% with the redesign, 9.5% in the Black Friday sale, 6.5% after. What did the redesign do?
why: The sale did the rest; never let one number take credit for another.
